'''Menelath''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Iol]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that was controlled by the company [[Tangan Industries]]. Menelath was the second-largest settlement on Iol and it was originally constructed to act as an extension of [[Haven (city)|Haven]], the world's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], that was situated nearer to Iol's mineral deposits. Menelath consisted of a large, primary dome, which contained most of the city's functions, while two additional domes contained the bulk of Menelath's residential zones. From about [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] to the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Menelath was ran by [[Tol Ferin]], a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] who held the position of [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] within Tagan Industries.<ref name="TUR" />
